title: Reach the explicit exception only after ordinary recovery
when: When a domain-specific recovery is unavailable and an authorized human administrator must review a bounded repair.
need: Learn the exact document, review, simulation and authority boundaries. Item columns use a public_ref name in snapshots and SQL while key_columns keeps the physical name; a non-key column such as deployment_member_item_id is deployment_member_public_ref, and the server resolves refs within the named project. A steering session still needs organization administrator authority and the operator's approved digest.
surface: New public reviewed-operator-repair guide; registered operator command described there
gap: The current public guide describes operator.data_repair.run, but the supplied root-help capture has no operator namespace. Review question: is this a release/help-scope difference, and what shipped discovery/refusal should reach the guide?
review: Item-reference update/delete, a non-key deployment_member_public_ref dry-run, simulation rollback and refusal behavior have candidate PostgreSQL tests in runtime/api/domain/test_operator_data_repair_items.py; shipped recipe proof remains pending.
